Sample Grok CLI (old)

Usage: grok [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]... [COMMAND]

Arguments:
  [PROMPT]...  Initial prompt for the interactive session

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see more with 'grok help')
  -m, --model <MODEL>
          Model ID to use (the list of models is shown in the app)

Commands:
  agent        Run the tool without the interactive UI
  doctor       Check terminal support
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
  login        Sign in
  models-info  Not the models command, just a lookalike name
  sessions     List, search, or restore sessions; shows models used
  version      Print version information
